detail.readme_excerpt: # pixelfx. **244 pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine. Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery. **[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) · [the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [how it works](#how-it-works) The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going. ## what's in it. | category | effects | some of them | |---|---|---| | **moves** | 12 | arrow shot, dash strike, earth stomp, fireball throw, ground pound, holy smite… | | **fire** | 12 | brazier, campfire, candle, fire breath, fire ring, fire tornado… | | **explosions** | 12 | barrel explosion, big explosion, cartoon pow, dirt explosion, firework burst, firework rocket… | | **water** | 12 | bubbles, drip, fountain, geyser, rain splash, ripples… | | **ice** | 10 | blizzard vortex, freeze, frost breath, frost nova, ice crystal, ice lance… | | **lightning** | 11 | ball lightning, chain lightning, charge up, electrified, lightning strike, plasma ball… | | **sci-fi** | 12 | emp blast, energy core, force field, glitch, hologram, jetpack… | | **melee** | 12 | claw swipe, dagger flurry, double slash, hammer smash, heavy cleave, scythe reap… | | **impacts** | 11 | blunt hit, bullet impact, critical hit, ground slam, heavy landing, hit flash… | | **projectiles** | 13 | arrow, bullet tracer, cannon shot, energy disc, signal flare, homing missile… | | **spawn & death** | 10 | coin drop, disintegrate, dissolve burn, egg hatch, poof, respawn beam… | | **arcane** | 12 | arcane beam, arcane missiles, arcane orb, blink in, blink out, magic circle cast… | | **holy** | 10 | blessing, divine shield, feather burst, halo, heal, healing ring… | | **shadow** | 12 | black hole, curse, dark explosion, eclipse, grasping hands, hex sigil… |
